title: 2 Weeks Forward Testing My XAUUSD EA — $500 → $746
author: _Mann_98_
selftext:
2 weeks of live forward testing completed. 

I've been testing a custom MT5 EA on XAUUSD using a cent account.

Starting balance: $500.00

Current balance: $746.33

Total profit: +$246.33

Return: +49.27%

The system is fully automated and uses rule-based recovery logic. Because of that, I'm not looking at profit alone—I’m also interested in how the system handles adverse moves and recovery cycles.

The goal is simply to keep the test running, collect more data, and see how it performs across different market conditions.
